name: fixbug-loop
description: Sua loi co ky luat: tai hien -> gia thuyet canh tranh -> test do -> sua toi thieu -> kiem chung
whenToUse: Co loi/exception/hanh vi sai chua ro nguyen nhan.
whenNotToUse: Da biet chinh xac dong nao sai va cach sua -> sua thang, van viet test.

outputs: Thong diep loi GOC day du (ca stack trace)
steps.exitCriteria: Tai hien duoc. KHONG tai hien duoc => noi ro; moi ket luan sau do la SUY DOAN va phai dan nhan.

steps.goal: Chong anchoring bang cach dung nhieu gia thuyet truoc khi dao sau cai nao
outputs: Voi moi cai: 'neu dung thi cai gi KHAC phai dung theo'
steps.exitCriteria: It nhat 3 gia thuyet, moi cai co mot phep thu BAC BO cu the
steps.note: Tim bang chung BAC BO, khong tim bang chung ung ho.

steps.goal: Bien bug thanh mot test that bai
steps.exitCriteria: Test DO, va do DUNG ly do bug gay ra. Neu no xanh ngay => chua hieu bug.

steps.goal: Sua NGUYEN NHAN, khong sua trieu chung
steps.exitCriteria: Khong refactor kem theo. Them try/catch quanh cho no la GIAU bug, khong phai sua.
Test moi XANH VA test cu khong do them. Ca hai, khong chi cai dau.

steps.goal: Mot bug hiem khi chi co mot cho
outputs: Danh sach cho khac trong repo co cung mau loi (ghi ra, KHONG sua)
steps.exitCriteria: Da grep mau loi tren toan repo

stopConditions.rule: cung cach sua that bai 3 lan
stopConditions.action: Chon MOT: doi gia thuyet | thu hep pham vi tai hien | dung va bao cao
